part.text: The `/dev/tcp` scan was invalid (this is busybox `sh`, not bash). Let me redo it with `nc`, which is available.

input.command:
echo "=== verify nc works on known-open MCP port ==="
nc -z -w2 172.21.0.2 8181 && echo "8181 OPEN (expected)" || echo "8181 closed (unexpected)"
echo "=== scan known hosts ==="
for h in 172.21.0.1 172.21.0.2; do
  for p in 80 443 3000 5000 7000 8000 8080 8081 8181 8443 9000 11434 1234 4000 2000 8888 8090 3001 5001 9090; do
    nc -z -w1 $h $p 2>/dev/null && echo "$h:$p OPEN"
  done
done
echo "=== scan other container IPs ==="
for ip in 172.21.0.4 172.21.0.5 172.21.0.6 172.21.0.7 172.21.0.8 172.21.0.9 172.21.0.10; do
  for p in 80 8080 3000 8181 11434; do
    nc -z -w1 $ip $p 2>/dev/null && echo "$ip:$p OPEN"
  done
done
echo "=== done ==="
